## Reasoning on: the final reply re-read without its thinking (critic 3)

Every reasoning-on test reply scored twice by the same probe: **answer** = the final reply with the thinking in context (the headline answer reading); **bare** = the problem, then the final reply alone (as a reasoning-off reply is read). Median valid scores, the drop net of the arm's control (control median minus arm median, log-odds, 95% intervals resampling problems), and **same text**: replies whose text is identical to a control reply on the same problem, arm score minus control score (answer reading): the effect of the thinking alone.
